notes.title: Baby, it's cold Outside! | Update V 0.3.1
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235766/478cbd863f8fa8ec89ec11aae1ea597b85dcf718.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235766/d366aab805c54f12268686cdd7cd43f151362b49.png[/img][/url]
[h1][b]NEW CONTENT - It's cold outside![/b][/h1]
Fire up your jetpack to explore the Intergalactic Ice biome that you have now the license to scavenge in.
[list]
[*] 4 New Ice maps to explore.
[*] New Icy environnement visuals 
[*] New Alien visual and behavior variations adapted to the Icy Biome
[*] New skins including santa and elf skin suits that can only be found in the Icy biome
[*] 2 special mission Events available in both biomes: Precious Egg Extraction, Langoliath Swarm
[*] New Tool: A Force Shield to deplay that can protect you and the ship from aliens
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235766/23491b48a1d55bb07944a9aaf80e532296ffe21f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235766/5d79f64acadfd92d0a5b2723ff1497d116c83e2a.png[/img][/url]
[h1][b]NEW FEATURES -  Show off your skills![/b] [/h1]
Show your survival skills and dedication to the Galactic Confederation with:
[*]Galactic Confederation Individual Objectives. When completing an objective, you gain a boost of your choice.
[*]Steam Achievements Implementation: 13 fun and mostly easy challenges. I dare you to unlock the "You're a Try Hard" success.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235766/35b5804af041db4e7262c9557b2f3778016d8d6a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235766/e475de42109f5a5dda1ffa4a161bfecce92ef459.png[/img][/url]
[h1][b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS [/b][/h1]
A dash of stability, a dash of smoothness, a dash of fun and a dash of prettiness. It's makes everything more savory. 
[list]
[*] Added mission counter in the ship to make sure have the proof of your survival claims.
[*] Fixed: Look at the Host as left the game randomly on start, and the fact that it breaks the mission right after
[*] New suitcases for the skins that showoff the skin inside
[*] Flare and Items have to be thrown in mouse direction - Keyboard Specific
[*] Fixed: Use Tool can interact with Launch system if someone is colliding it
[*] Improved the Komet movement around the map angles.
[*] Implemented specific message for mission crew left the HQ lobby with shuttle or launch countdown has started.
[*] Reworked the Grab & Throw mechanic to ensure a more consistent force applied
[*] When you redeem the thombstone of a fallen Anglernaut, you'll be able to get their suit look and tools back. It's to your discretion if you give it back or use it for yourself.
[/list]

Next update, you can expect a monster update as in a lote more monsters! And other quality of life improvements like a baby difficulty level and the host transfer and identification.

Have a cool time in Mad Void scrapping operation and continue to repay your Void debt!

Best Regards,
The Sentry Games team, delegation of the Galactic Confederation.

ps: As a lovely bonus, you can incite your friends to get Mad Void and Ritual Night for amazing nights of cooperation and deception! Find the bundle here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48397/Chaotic_Cosmic_Coops/]Check out the Chaotic Cosmic Co-ops BUNDLE[/url]

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Coming back to main menu after mission and losing mouse cursor
[*] Fixed some issues with joining lobby with code while players where launching the shuttle
[*] Fixed Blackhole attraction zone that was too wide compare to visual effect
[*] Changed background music to facilitate content creation 
[/list]

notes.title: MAD VOID MAJOR UPDATE V0.2.0 - Happy Together
notes.notes:
Hello Anglernauts! 

We cannot be more excited to open Mad Void to more scrappers! We're coming to you with a new message of the Galactic Confederation: 

[u][h2]Major Content Update[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] First, the mission crew limit has been expanded from 4 members to an 8 person crew complement! 
[*] That's not all, we have developed a new technology to help Anglernauts distinguish themselves during missions. You'll be able to equip space suit accessories thank to the high tech suitcase adroned with a golden question mark.
[*] Additionally we have render the Interface readable in more languages to reflect the various earth dialects picked up during missions.
[*] We have upgrade your destination selections to find more exotic locations, with destructible asteroid walls and also find special mission destinations.
[*] The special mission will yield higher rewards but there topography might throw you through a loop. You'll recognize them to there special key icon on the destination selection screen.
[*] Beware there is a new detected space danger called, Komet that roams your mission destinations. 
[*] On a positive note, the Galactic Confederation now recognize more sellable items like the Langoliath plushie and the Langoliath tentacle. This will get you even more Void Coins to help you reimburse your debt. 
[*] As we want to recognize the individual efforts, you'll be awarded titles at the end of each successful exploration during missions.
[/list]
[u][h2]Improvements and bug fixes[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Disk file size optimization
[*] Rework icons to have keyboard icons instead of text
[*] Fixed the fact that Voidification was applied while in periscope mode
[*] Fixed the fact that dying in periscope mode locked you in periscope mode if you didn't quit the game
[*] Fixed items position to avoid floating items
[*] Fixed Blackhole desintegration. BEWARE THE BLACKHOLE IS MORE DEADLY (has it should be)!
[*] Fixed voidification / Range boarder so coming back into the in range sage zone is better taken into consideration
[*] Fixed the fact that Teleporting from the voidification zone to a safe zone didn't stop the voidification death.
[*] Increased item throw strength
[*] implemented a clear visual for the voidification zone / out of range zone.
[*] implemented visual effect for acid death
[*] implemented thumbstone to sell after crewmate died.
[*] implemented visual effect for bulking tool
[*] Impelmented visual feedback when putting items to sell in spaceship.
[*] implemented icons for difficulty level
[*] improved lights in death scene
[*] fixed settings and credits menu input to leave them on the controller with a simple back B button.
[*] fixed music that was not looping or stopped playing
[*] implemented animation to show that player is selecting a destination. It's turning it's back to camera.
[*] Improved Plantrunner behavior so it doesn't get stuck in a wall and REALLY gets after you.
[*] implemented the mimic monster on more sellable items
[*] improved some issues with joining a room with a code
[*] improved text for join mission with code errors.
[*] When health is below 100%, it now removes the first 0 (previously provided values such as "060% health")
[*] Clean spawn point if player joins a mission that has already collected voids.
[*] improved items placement on player back
[*] Fixed incorrect supplies credited when joining a mission that has already collected voids
[*] Improved sound balance to have the voice chat be a bit louder.
[*] Being grabbed while selecting destination now cancels destination selection.
[/list]

It's a blast to work on those updates. We've also updated the roadmap to reflect more closely with planned features and content. Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: Mad Void - Official release date annoucement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have a good news for you. It's coming November 12th at midnight Central European Time or November 11th at 3PM Pacific Standard Time. 

We're a small team so it would mean the universe to us if we get your support at launch. Steam ecosystem is as harsh as our fantastical deep space and we can use all the jet fuel we can get. You can expect a small promotion at launch to help you get on the Shuttle without an itch. ;)

Happy Scrapping on November 12th!
